environment: Python 3 (python3 -I, scratch cwd), Node test runner, worktree of sdlc/S-fix-M-1-1b at e979556

cases.title: State names keep the given ts and build one when absent
cases.given: Formats sdlc/{name}, Feat/{name:lower}, x/{name}-y; state kind with no ts, empty ts, valid ts and bad ts values
cases.when: Call name for each ts, including ts values that end in a line feed or carriage return
cases.then: No ts or empty ts builds a 14-digit UTC stamp near now; a given 14-digit ts is used as given; every bad ts raises Fail
cases.expected: Bad ts raises Fail; a missing ts still succeeds
cases.actual: Passed. Short, long, letters, fullwidth and Arabic-indic digits, leading or trailing space, LF, CR, CRLF, NUL and U+2028 raised Fail. The built stamp was within 2 minutes of now. Integer ts 20261011101010 returned sdlc/state-20261011101010
cases.specSource: R-019 acceptance: every name output parses back to the same parts

cases.title: Property: any name output parses back to the same kind and parts
cases.given: Seed 20261011; 3000 random calls over 13 formats, 8 kinds, adversarial ids, integers, areas, profiles and ts values
cases.when: Call name, then parse the result, compare with a reference model written from the spec
cases.then: Outcome is return or Fail, never an exception; every returned branch parses back to the same kind and parts
cases.actual: 641 returned, 2359 raised Fail, 0 exceptions, 0 violations. The r0 line feed counterexample no longer returns
cases.specSource: R-019 acceptance: every name output parses back to the same parts

cases.title: Property: valid parts give the reference name and round-trip
cases.given: Seed 20261012; 2000 random valid kind and part sets over 5 formats
cases.then: name equals the reference name; parse returns the same parts
